tldr: An e-mail inbox can now send replies in its own HTML layout, written in Liquid. The account can set a fallback layout. The branded_email_templates feature flag turns it on per account.
goal: Let a company that runs several brands from a single account send each brand's replies in that brand's e-mail design.

story.heading: E-mail templates now belong to an inbox too
story.body: inbox_id joins account_id. 3 partial unique indexes keep 1 template per name, type and locale for each scope.

story.heading: The resolver looks for the inbox layout first
story.body: For an e-mail inbox with the flag on, the order is inbox, then account, then installation, each by locale with English as the fallback.

story.heading: Replies render through the branded layout
story.body: ConversationReplyMailer sets the current inbox and uses the base layout for email_reply and reply_without_summary when a layout exists.

story.heading: The layout reads the inbox through Liquid
story.body: InboxDrop now gives business_name, avatar_url and email to the template, next to the agent, the contact and the message.

story.heading: Admins set layouts through the API
story.body: A new endpoint sets the account layout. The inbox update takes branded_email_layout, in the same transaction as the other inbox fields.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: The REST API writes layouts into Inboxes. E-mail delivery reads them when it renders a reply. No dependency breaks a rule.

components.summary: New branded_email_layout endpoint for the account; the inbox update and its JSON include the inbox layout.
EmailTemplate gets an inbox scope, Liquid and layout checks; Inbox can read, find and update its branded layout.
The resolver finds inbox, account, then installation layouts by locale; replies render through the branded layout.
New branded_email_templates feature flag, Current.inbox, and the migrations for the inbox scope.

decisions.title: 3 scopes with a fixed order: inbox, account, installation
decisions.why: A brand per inbox overrides the account layout, and the installation layout stays the last fallback.

decisions.title: Partial unique indexes, 1 per scope
decisions.why: A plain unique index cannot treat NULL account or inbox ids as a scope. Each partial index guards a single scope.
decisions.alternative: Validate uniqueness only in the model.

decisions.title: Check the Liquid and the layout slot on save
decisions.why: A layout without {{ content_for_layout }} or with bad Liquid fails at save time, not when a reply goes out.
decisions.alternative: Accept any body and fail when the mailer renders it.

decisions.title: A feature flag, off by default
decisions.why: branded_email_templates turns the layouts on per account. The resolver and the API check it before they use a layout.

decisions.title: Current.inbox carries the inbox to the resolver
decisions.why: Rails calls the view resolver without the mailer's objects. Current.inbox gives the resolver the inbox of the reply.
decisions.alternative: Pass the inbox through the view details.
